resources.string: Rasul answers messages that people send to the linked WhatsApp number.
You talk to Rasul in your own \"Message yourself\" chat.
Up to %1$d numbers separated by commas. Digits only, with an optional + at the start.
Use digits only, with an optional + at the start, like +10000000000. Separate several numbers with commas.
This text is too long. Remove the extra characters.
Waiting for you to scan the code
On the phone that has the WhatsApp account, open WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device, then scan this code.
QR code for linking WhatsApp. Scan it with WhatsApp on the phone that has the account.
Anyone who scans this code can link your WhatsApp account. Keep this screen to yourself.
Apply saves this connection in Rasul on your PC. It may need a restart afterwards.
The agent is busy; apply anyway? Applying restarts the agent and stops any work in progress.
The WhatsApp connector is missing from Rasul on the computer. Update Rasul, then try again.
The WhatsApp connector could not be installed on the computer. Check its internet connection, then try again.
Installing the WhatsApp connector took too long. Try again.
WhatsApp logged this device out. Start again to link it.
This WhatsApp setup was cancelled on the computer. Start again.
Saved values are never shown. Leave a field empty to keep it as it is.
This setting name is not valid.
A value can have at most 4096 characters.
Use plain letters, digits and symbols only.
This looks like a hidden preview, not a real value. Paste the full value.
Change at most %1$d settings at a time.
This channel has no such setting. Refresh the list and try again.
Rasul refused one of the values. Check them and try again.
A value looks like a hidden preview, for example it contains ****. Paste the full value instead.
